concept.title: Inside a project
concept.shortdesc: Opening a project shows the project menu with its pages, grouped under Define, Verify, Plan and Agents on the rail down the left (see Getting started → Finding your way around):

strow.stentry: Product definition, metrics, personas, needs, interviews
The artifact tree — create, edit, link, baseline
Step-by-step wizard from framing to committed requirements
Coverage, gaps, test runs, PDF report
Kanban board with human and agent assignees
Crew builder — org chart of agents and people
Agent run history and proposal review
Project access, repositories, agent auth, danger zone

conbody.p: Projects at the top of the rail takes you back to all projects. The account menu at the right end of the top bar (on a phone, your name at the foot of the project menu) opens Settings (personal runner and agent sign-ins) and Sign out.
